title: Ecosystem
intro: Asmoday only does files, media and terminals. Everything below is delegated to mature tools through WebDAV or a shared directory.

items.syncthing: Peer-to-peer incremental sync. Mirror folders from your phone or desktop straight into an Asmoday mount.
items.photosync: Back up your phone camera roll in the background over the WebDAV endpoint Asmoday provides.
items.foldersync: A capable multi-platform folder sync tool that can mirror specific directories over WebDAV on a schedule.
items.ariang: The built-in download engine speaks the aria2 RPC protocol. Fill in the address and secret for a familiar web task manager.
items.raidrive: Mount Asmoday's WebDAV as a Windows network drive and read and write it straight from File Explorer.
items.cyberduck: A graphical WebDAV client for macOS and Windows; drag and drop to upload or download.
items.winscp: A long-standing Windows transfer client with WebDAV credential storage and scripted operations.
items.caddy: Exposing Asmoday to the internet? Caddy's reverse proxy issues HTTPS certificates automatically; X-Forwarded-* headers are supported natively.
items.tailscale: Prefer not to expose anything? Build a virtual LAN and reach your devices safely from anywhere.
items.picgo: Point PicGo at Asmoday's direct image URLs so pasted screenshots upload while you write.
items.typora: A WYSIWYG Markdown editor; wire its image service to PicGo and uploads go straight to Asmoday.
items.obsidian: A local-first Markdown knowledge base; keep your vault inside a synced folder and share it across devices.

footer: Asmoday grows thanks to the open-source and commercial tools above. Click any card to visit its official site.
